jobs.title: GIS Technician
jobs.description:
**The Opportunity**

Ulteig has an outstanding opportunity for a GIS Technician with a focus on supporting the Environmental Department. Ulteig is looking to have this position filled by the first week of January 2027. This integral role is a technical specialist for various types of projects using geospatial technology. The GIS Technician is fully competent and knows the application of all conventional aspects and principles of GIS. The Technician will perform GIS tasks which include creating and managing geospatial data, including shapefiles, file geodatabases, and hosted web services. The ideal candidate has basic knowledge of environmental and cultural data and workflows. Coordinates technical GIS activities, project assignments, and information with technical team leads, environmental professionals, engineers, surveyors, planners, and other technical staff as necessary.

  

**What You'll Do**

* Conduct data gathering, editing, conversion, and analysis of GIS data with a focus on environmental data, including public environmental datasets along with field-collected data.
* Leverage ArcGIS Field Maps coupled with ArcGIS Online web maps to support environmental field data collection, data management, access to data, and the creation of professional cartographic figures.
* Apply cartographic standard principles to prepare maps and exhibits using GIS data sets.
* Prepare data documentation and metadata for GIS projects.
* Monitor quality control within the area of responsibility before submitting to the project manager for review.
* Collaborate with technical leads, engineers, planners, surveyors, and other technical staff as necessary.
* Review all work for completeness and accuracy prior to final submission.
* Provide an accurate accounting of time spent on projects with descriptions for each time entry daily.
* Provide GIS analysis and decision support to the appropriate department.
* Review projects for compliance with applicable industry design and safety codes, client or company design and quality standards.
* Provide outstanding client service.
* Provide assistance with technical team leads and client solutions on additional business opportunities.
* Work collaboratively with individuals at all levels in the organization in a team environment.
* Comply with all company and client safety standards.
* Ensure personal/ professional information is accurate and maintained.
* Participate in professional development activities.
* Work closely with other disciplines on multi-discipline projects.

  

**What We Expect from You**

* Minimum two-year technical degree in Geography, Environmental, Computer Science, GIS, Engineering, Urban Planning, or related field
* Minimum of 1 year of professional experience.
* Basic knowledge of environmental data, concepts, and workflows.
* Basic knowledge of current GIS technology and software applications.
* Basic knowledge of Esri suite of products, especially ArcGIS Pro, Field Maps, and ArcGIS Online.
* Basic knowledge of geodatabases, editing, geoprocessing tools, map projections, and cartography principles.
* Working knowledge of Microsoft Software Applications (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Access), and Office 365.
* Must possess a well-rounded knowledge of commonly used concepts, practices, and procedures related to GIS.
* Demonstrates excellent verbal/written communication, time management, interpersonal, organizational, and graphical communication skills.
* Demonstrates the ability to be organized and work on multiple projects and meet deadlines by setting priorities.
* Demonstrates openness to innovation by embracing and applying evolving technology and AI tools to enhance workflows, solve problems, and drive continuous improvement.
* Must have authorization to work permanently in the U.S.

  

*As you consider applying for a position at Ulteig, we encourage you to think outside the box – because we do! You might not meet 100% of the skills listed in a description, but we are committed to hiring people with exceptional talent, ability, and potential, and then creating an environment where they can become the best versions of themselves. We don’t want to miss out on the possibility of speaking with the next outstanding Ulteig team members, so please apply if you think this role is a great match for your unique skills and strengths. And yes, relevant military experience is absolutely considered for transitioning service members.*

  

**What You Can Expect from Ulteig**

Ulteig is a purpose-driven organization that has built a culture focused on people, both our clients and our employees, for over 80 years. Working at Ulteig is more than a job, opening opportunities to make an impact by creating and solving for a sustainable future. We recognize our success relies heavily on the dedication and focus of our workforce; this is why we make investing in our employees a top priority. We prioritize flexibility and staying connected to meeting your needs and helping you achieve your goals. We value your unique perspective, respect your individuality, and celebrate your contributions. At Ulteig, we take our success and the success of our clients personally.

**We offer our team members:**

* Flexible Workplace
* Employee Ownership
* Competitive Pay
* Comprehensive Benefits Package
* Collaborative Environment
* Innovative Culture

Our vision is to be the most trusted partners transforming our world’s critical infrastructure. Ulteig connects people and resources to develop compelling, integrated solutions across multiple Lifeline Sectors®, including Power, Renewables, Transportation, and Water. Ulteig is a trusted partner in engineering North America’s essential infrastructure and leverages its expertise with a wide range of public and private clients.

jobs.title: Digital Technology Consultant (environmental engineering)
jobs.description:
Brown and Caldwell (BC), a leading environmental engineering firm, is currently seeking a Digital Technology Consultant to serve as a task lead supporting our Digital Solutions team.

The Digital Technology Consulting role is responsible for developing digital technology strategies, evaluating and implementing technology solutions, and helping water and wastewater clients advance their digital objectives. This includes supporting initiatives related to data management, business intelligence and dashboarding, enterprise reporting, AI enabled solutions, system integration, and digital transformation efforts. This role will lead tasks assessing the state of clients’ data environments, digital systems, reporting capabilities, and related business processes to identify opportunities for improvements and future-state requirements.

This role works closely with clients to develop technology roadmaps, evaluate and select solutions, establish supporting business processes, and guide implementation efforts through deployment and adoption. Responsibilities include leading the development of advanced BI reports and dashboards, recommending optimizations for enterprise applications, and collaborating with technical staff in the design and implementation of data integration and analytics solutions. This role will apply recognized data management and governance practices, including DAMA-DMBOK principles, to assess data capabilities, define governance approaches, improve data quality and accessibility, and develop practical roadmaps that maximize the business value of client data assets.

Work is performed independently with limited supervision and occasional guidance for complex or strategic issues. The role will also support and lead engagement with Clients to develop concepts into projects, support prepositioning meetings with clients ahead of RFP release, development of RFP responses and support creating scopes of work and fee estimates.

The selected candidate may be located in either Pacific or Mountain time zones although our ideal candidate will be located near one of our Northern California offices such as Walnut Creek, San Francisco, San Jose or Sacramento.

**Responsibilities**

* Communicate the technology planning approach and frameworks to clients.
* Lead the execution of services for enterprise technology planning, selection/evaluation/implementation of information systems to support client’s business processes and integrating technologies to help clients make the best use of their data, systems, and tools.
* Lead teams to identify, design and implement innovative digital solutions helping clients align technology initiatives with business goals.
* Responsible for all aspects of small to mid-size projects with low degree of technical complexity, involving a small project staff
* Ensure data governance of digital solutions created are in compliance with BC technical standards and cybersecurity policies.
* Lead the design, development, and implementation of data management initiatives, dashboarding, AI embedded tools, reporting and general digital transformation efforts.
* Provide strategic insights through data analysis.
* Facilitate client discussions and make presentations on the status and future initiatives regarding digital technology plans and usage.
* Differentiate between client needs for basic data integration tasks and the development of more complex data engineering pipelines and lead digital solutions technical staff in implementing the identified solutions.
* Provide training and support to less experienced colleagues for their development and understanding of digital technology consulting.
* Support business development activities and lead development of scopes, schedules, and budgets.
* Flexibility to adapt and execute various additional assignments, including PM-related duties, based on evolving needs.

**Mentorship**

* May provide mentorship, guidance, support, and knowledge-sharing to help less experienced team members develop their skills and grow within their roles.

**Skills and Competencies**

* Advanced knowledge of enterprise applications used in the water/wastewater engineering sector (CMMS, GIS, SCADA, LIMS and Data Technologies) and designing digital solutions to use their data for analysis and business intelligence visualization.
* Expertise in data management and data governance frameworks and policies.
* Strong ability in identifying and designing digital solutions that integrate business IT system data with time-series datasets from sensors and SCADA networks.
* Excellent data analysis, BI tool proficiency, enterprise reporting, and technical problem-solving skills.
* Skilled in facilitating client discussions and presenting work outcomes effectively.
* Demonstrated expertise in creating and implementing processes and plans making effective use of data and digital technology.
* Capacity to support other team members in technology consulting skills development.
* Keeps up to date with digital technology and data management practices, principles, and developments in the water/wastewater industry.

**Experience**

* Typically, a minimum of 5 years of relevant experience is required.
* Experience working with data from water/wastewater-related enterprise applications (e.g., CMMS, GIS, LIMS, SCADA, PMIS, Asset Management etc.)
* Typically will become certified in BC's Subject Matter Specialist (SMS) Framework and progress through the SMS competencies.

**Preferred Experience**

* 10+ years of relevant experience.
* Strong subject matter expertise in a core application water/wastewater application (SCADA, CMMS, GIS, LIMS, AMI etc.).
* Experience supporting and leading sales activities.
* Experience in leading digital tasks and projects with an emphasis on a client-facing role.
* Experience applying DAMA-DMBOK or comparable data management frameworks.
* Experience with data governance, data quality, metadata, data architecture, integration, master data, and/or data
